citation_or_source: This work, Foldseek web API ticket jY9SwSBmjnQLFlx-CfUlg-GFY-1CP5W6EtfBTw
evidence_type: Computational, structure search (3Di+AA) of AF-O16224-F1-v6 vs pdb100, cath50, afdb-swissprot, afdb-proteome, afdb50, mgnify_esm30, bfvd_v3
claim_tested: IRG-2 adopts a known fold detectable by structural search
key_finding: 428 hits. Every non-nematode hit is non-significant: best E = 1.666 (cath50 3.30.420.10), 2.746 (cath50 3.40.140.10), 3.268 (pdb100 4ani_D), 4.223 (afdb-swissprot MJ0365), 8.501 (bfvd_v3). Identities 5.8-16.3%, query coverage 0.14-0.40, self-computed TM-scores 0.100-0.195, all far below the 0.5 same-fold threshold.
context: In silico; AlphaFold model, mean pLDDT 68.7
confidence_and_limitations: High confidence in the negative. Limitation: model is only moderately confident and 20.5% of residues are very low pLDDT; Foldseek recall falls below 50% for the most remote homologies.

citation_or_source: This work, Foldseek controls (tmalign mode; crop 14-170; crop 70-197 Pfam boundaries)
claim_tested: A weak fold signal is hidden by disordered flanks or by 3Di scoring
key_finding: TM-align mode full length: one cath50 hit 2hiyB01, prob 0.02, E=0.3066, 1.3% identity; nothing in pdb100 or afdb-swissprot. Crop 14-170: best cath50 E=1.613, pdb100 E=5.453. Crop 70-197: best afdb-swissprot E=0.2419 (inositol polyphosphate multikinase, prob 0.277, 10.8% identity), cath50 E=0.533, pdb100 E=1.654.
confidence_and_limitations: High. A recurring sub-threshold tilt toward CATH 3.30.420.10 (RNase H-like) and DNA-polymerase exonuclease domains is noted but is not actionable at E > 0.2.

citation_or_source: This work, RCSB BioZernike shape search, upload key 5c09d8e2-1c31-4d86-bdd4-05a05c8e1e30
evidence_type: Computational, 3D moment-invariant shape search (algorithm independent of Foldseek)
claim_tested: A fold match exists in the PDB that alignment-based search missed
key_finding: strict_shape_match and relaxed_shape_match both returned HTTP 204 No Content: zero PDB polymer entities of similar global shape.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Global-shape search is insensitive to partial-domain similarity, so it corroborates rather than extends the Foldseek negative.

evidence_type: Database, precomputed domain and fold classification
claim_tested: An existing classification already implies a fold for IRG-2
key_finding: The entire InterPro match set across all member databases is two entries, IPR063296 (Infection response protein 2, alpha/beta domain) and PF28668 (IRG2_N), both residues 70-197. No Gene3D, SUPERFAMILY, CATH-Gene3D, PANTHER, CDD, SMART, PROSITE or PIRSF match. InterPro records 0 structures for the entry.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Absence of a SUPERFAMILY or Gene3D match is independent evidence that no HMM-detectable fold family applies.

citation_or_source: This work, Foldseek, nematode hits; UniProt query xref:pfam-PF28668
evidence_type: Computational, structure search plus family enumeration
claim_tested: IRG-2's significant structural neighbours define a characterised family
key_finding: All significant hits are nematode IRG2_ab proteins: C. briggsae A0AAE8ZV55 E=5.19e-30 TM=0.697, C. elegans O16222 E=3.06e-28 TM=0.727, C. remanei A0A6A5GGM3 E=1.51e-28 TM=0.706, C. brenneri G0NHN2 E=2.20e-28, B1GRK2 E=1.91e-25 TM=0.674, B1GRK3 E=9.17e-24, Q9N5I0 E=4.65e-23, Q9BI97 E=2.73e-20, Q17706 E=2.30e-18, Q18638 E=1.50e-17, O45909 E=7.48e-12. PF28668 has 152 members, 151 Nematoda (Caenorhabditis 138, Strongyloides 9, Plectus 3, Pristionchus 1) plus one Bugula neritina entry that is probably contamination. irg-2 is C49G7.5 and C49G7.7, C49G7.10, C49G7.12 sit in the same genomic cluster.
confidence_and_limitations: High for the family boundary. The family is entirely uncharacterised biochemically, so the hits carry no transferable function.

citation_or_source: This work, UniProt and InterPro records of the top structural hits
claim_tested: The protein names on IRG-2's top hits imply a function (anoctamin, glycosyltransferase, sulfotransferase)
key_finding: O16222 displays as 'Anoctamin', B1GRK2 as 'Glycosyltransferase family 92 protein', B1GRK3 as 'Glycosyltransferase family 17 protein', Q9N5I0 as 'DUF4130 domain-containing protein', O45909 as 'Sulfotransfer_1 domain-containing protein'. All are unreviewed TrEMBL. Each carries exactly one InterPro and one Pfam entry, IPR063296 / PF28668, and no anoctamin, glycosyltransferase, sulfotransferase or DUF4130 domain. UniProt has already renamed Q9BI97, Q17706, Q18638 and Q966A4 to 'Infection response protein 2 alpha/beta domain-containing protein'.
confidence_and_limitations: High. This is the single largest annotation-transfer risk for this gene.

citation_or_source: This work, PF28668 domain co-occurrence across 152 members
claim_tested: Domain context suggests a biochemical setting for the IRG2_ab fold
key_finding: 21 of 152 PF28668 proteins (13.8%) also carry a RING or IBR domain: PF01485 IBR (18), PF13445 zf-RING_UBOX (3), PF22191 IBR_1 (1), PF13639 zf-RING_2 (1), in C. elegans (Q966A5/Y58A7A.4, 904 aa; Q966A6/Y58A7A.3, 883 aa), C. briggsae, C. remanei, C. latens, C. nigoni, C. tropicalis, C. auriculariae, four Strongyloides species, Pristionchus mayeri, Plectus sambesii. Median length of RBR-fused members 887 aa vs 283 aa for the rest. IRG-2 itself has no accessory domain.
confidence_and_limitations: Low to moderate. Other co-occurrences (Col_cuticle_N, Collagen, Galactosyl_T, 7TM_GPCR_Str, EHN) look like chimeric gene models, so some RBR fusions may also be mis-assembled. Inference only.

citation_or_source: This work, conservation and burial analysis, 110-member structural MSA
evidence_type: Computational, evolutionary rate and solvent accessibility
claim_tested: Conserved residues form a solvent-accessible site consistent with catalysis or binding
key_finding: 153 positions with coverage >= 20 and pLDDT >= 70. Most conserved: Y74 0.971, K40 0.951, Y187 0.864, G156 0.848, V72 0.765, R108 0.706, D67 0.685, N195 0.679, H139 0.657. Conservation rises with burial (Spearman rho=0.270, p=7.42e-4, n=153; Mann-Whitney top-30 vs rest U=2426, p=3.74e-3). Nine conserved polar residues (K40, T41, H43, D67, Y74, E107, R108, H139, Y187) form one 10 A-linked cluster, permutation p=0.047 (5000 draws, null mean 4.87). Shrake-Rupley RSA: cluster median 0.085 vs 0.303 overall; K40 and T41 fully buried at 0.000.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. The clustering is borderline and the pattern fits fold stabilisation by a buried Lys-Asp-Tyr triad and a buried Glu-His pair rather than a substrate-accessible active site.

citation_or_source: This work, Foldseek positive controls, tickets 9sV2ta0bb1zj9TflQ7N3CjYpjBnf-FMt5GUU_w and IA_p8qxcJnKuVtIsbN2_dU3CHBvgB29CrUTMxw
evidence_type: Computational, method validation on two C. elegans proteins
claim_tested: The pipeline can detect a fold when one is present
key_finding: PMK-1 (Q17446): pdb100 1bl6_A p38 MAPK E=5.140e-47, 66.5% identity, coverage 0.90; cath50 1.10.510.10 E=1.659e-39; afdb-swissprot MAPK14 E=6.862e-50. IRG-1 (O16327), the irg gene co-regulated with irg-2 by zip-2: pdb100 8bau_A NADAR with ADP-ribose E=1.904e-08, 28.2% identity, coverage 0.97; cath50 1.10.357.40 YbiA-like E=5.444e-15; afdb-swissprot N-glycosidase YbiA P30176 E=1.331e-07. The IRG-1 call matches its curated Pfam PF08719 / InterPro IPR012816 NADAR annotation.
context: In silico, same pipeline and settings as the IRG-2 run
confidence_and_limitations: High. Shows the negative is not caused by nematode lineage restriction, small size, or search failure.

claim_tested: Existing experimental literature constrains IRG-2 molecular function
key_finding: zip-2 encodes a bZIP transcription factor required for induction of irg-1 and for defence against Pseudomonas aeruginosa. irg-2 belongs to this induced set. No molecular activity, localization or interaction is reported for IRG-2.
context: C. elegans, intestine, P. aeruginosa PA14 infection
confidence_and_limitations: High for the regulatory claim, silent on molecular function.

claim_tested: The pathway upstream of irg-2 induction
key_finding: P. aeruginosa Exotoxin A blocks intestinal translation, which raises ZIP-2 levels and drives the irg response.
confidence_and_limitations: High for the pathway, silent on IRG-2 molecular function.

key_finding: A Chondrus crispus extract induces irg-2 together with other immune genes.
confidence_and_limitations: Expression evidence only. Supports an induced-under-stress expression pattern, not a molecular function.
